maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is from claims adjusting and third-party administration services for insurers and self-insured clients, not repair or maintenance of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Clients are mainly private insurers and corporations paying for claims handling and TPA services, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by organic claims services; Broadspire, GAB Robins and WeGoLook were occasional acquisitions, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Outsourced claims handling and TPA services are embedded in insurer workflows and regulated, so switching causes disruption and risk.
